name: guidance-override
description: A guidance override in the config replaces the tool snippet and guidelines in the request; an invalid one falls back.
setup: mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/rpiv-web-tools" && printf '%s' '{"guidance": {"web_search": {"promptSnippet": "Custom search snippet", "promptGuidelines": ["Rule S1", "Rule S2"]}, "web_fetch": {"promptSnippet": 123, "promptGuidelines": "not an array"}}}' > "$HOME/.config/rpiv-web-tools/config.json"
